text: kaya: Build broke on main during the Docusaurus docsite deploy, linkcheck reported duplicate anchor ids across different pages. Here's the snippet from the logs: > ERROR: Duplicate anchor `configuration` found in /reference/api.md and /reference/cli.md > This causes the sidebar link to resolve unpredictably. kaya: Both pages have a top-level heading `Configuration`. Previously this wasn't failing because the old slugger included the filename, but after the plugin upgrade slugs are global and collide. tomas: Ah yeah we upgraded `@docusaurus/remark-plugin` in #1523. The new slugger normalizes headings differently and removes filename scoping. We need to either make headings unique or add explicit anchors. lee: Quick options: - Rename one heading (least invasive) - Add explicit HTML anchor: `` above the heading - Add frontmatter `id: reference-cli-configuration` (Docusaurus supports `id`) - Or use a slugify hook to include the filename in the generated id kaya: I pushed a small PR that renames the CLI page heading to `CLI configuration` to avoid the collision: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/1602 sasha: Renaming is fine, but we have many such collisions in the reference section. We should either patch the plugin or run a preprocessor that prepends the file path to anchors. Otherwise we'll keep hitting this on merges. tomas: Agreed. I'll prototype a slugify hook that uses `path.basename(filePath) + '--' + slug(heading)` so it stays stable and unique across files. lee: If we go with slugify hook, add a migration step in docs CI that warns on collisions to catch anything missed. Also update the CONTRIBUTING docs so authors know not to rely on automatic global slugs. kaya: For immediate unblock I accepted the rename PR and restarted the deploy. Build queued. build-bot: deploy-docs job #5887 started for branch `main` (triggered by kaya). build-bot: deploy-docs job #5887 failed: linkcheck (1 error). See logs: https://ci.internal.redwood.dev/5887 kaya: Hmm still one failure, looks like another pair: `Getting started` headings on `intro.md` and `overview.md` collided because both had `Getting started` and the new slugger normalizes `Getting started`->`getting-started` for both. sasha: Could we add a lightweight lint rule in `tools/docs-lint` that checks for duplicate top-level slugs and fails locally before pushing? I'd rather catch this earlier. tomas: I'll add tests and a small CLI `tools/docs-validate.py` that loads all markdown, computes slugs with the new hook, and reports duplicates. We can add it as a pre-commit hook and to CI's docs-check stage. lee: Open an issue so we can track the platform change vs stopgap fixes. Filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/issues/410 - "Docsite: make heading slugs file-scoped or add duplicate detection" kaya: Cool. I'll follow up with a short PR to add `tools/docs-validate.py` and the pre-commit hook. For now I've added a temporary explicit anchor in `overview.md` to unblock the deploy: `` above the heading. build-bot: deploy-docs job #5890 passed on `main` (checks: linkcheck, lint). :white_check_mark: sasha: Nice cleanup. After Tomas lands the slugify hook let's run a sweep to remove explicit HTML anchors and harmonize headings back to concise forms. kaya: Thanks everyone. If you see any odd anchor warnings in opened PRs, tag me and I'll help triage. :sparkles:
